lines.en: A girl with special eyes — the kind that remind you of an unnamed celestial body taking cover behind several tree canopies, distributing its light among the leaves and feeding them the correct brand of radiation.
lines.zh: 一个有着特殊眼睛的女孩——那种让你想起某颗无名天体的眼睛:它躲在几重树冠后,把光分给叶片,喂养它们正确品牌的辐射。

lines.en: In the daylight, where the majority of these bodies can not be seen or witnessed, is when it’s safest to lurk through the foliage the way I’m doing now.
lines.zh: 在日光之下——大多数这类天体无法被看见或见证的时刻——才是像我现在这样潜伏于枝叶间最安全的时候。

lines.en: But in springtime, some of that safety begins to dissipate.
lines.zh: 但到了春天,那份安全便开始消散。

lines.en: You see, this is when nature is the hungriest. Because the everblooming nature of nature’s nature isn’t all that natural when you really think about it.
lines.zh: 要知道,这正是自然最饥饿的时候。因为,仔细想想,自然之本性那永不凋谢的本性,其实没那么自然。

lines.en: The colors makes the other colors hungry.
lines.zh: 一些颜色让另一些颜色饥饿。

lines.en: Or jealous.
lines.zh: 或者嫉妒。

lines.en: And that envy propels them to feast on more of those unknown celestial eyes or light or whatever it was to increase their colors and make their patterns more distinct.
lines.zh: 那份嫉妒驱使它们吞食更多那些未知的天体之眼、或光、或随便那是什么,以增添自己的颜色,让自己的花纹更清晰。

lines.en: If you can’t identify which flowers you shan’t eat, it makes it easier for those flowers to eat you. And consuming the blood of a human just accelerates that floral desire to out-flora the florum.
lines.zh: 如果你分辨不出哪些花是你不该吃的,那些花吃起你来就更容易。而吞食人类的血,只会加速那份花想要比 florum 更花的花之欲望。

lines.en: EDITOR’S NOTE: Florum /ˈflôrəm/ ~ Multiple types of flora combining to create one universal floral entity [[EX: lesser god/cottontail].
lines.zh: 编者注:Florum /ˈflôrəm/ ~ 多种植物相合而成的一个普遍花卉实体 [[例:次级神明/棉尾兔]。

lines.en: But anyway, yeah. That’s what those special eyes remind me of.
lines.zh: 不过总之,是的。那些特殊的眼睛就让我想起这些。

lines.en: They remind me of a lot of other things as well. But that’s exactly why I’m so unsettled by the existence of the non-floral entity I’m searching for.
lines.zh: 它们还让我想起很多别的东西。而这恰恰是为什么,我正在寻找的那个非花卉实体的存在,让我如此不安。

lines.en: If it joins the florum, cutting it down won’t be as easy as slipping on a pair of gardening gloves and propagating some pieces to replant in a tiny ceramic pot.
lines.zh: 如果它加入 florum,再想除掉它,可就不像戴上园艺手套、剪下几段枝条插进小小陶盆里重新栽种那么容易了。

lines.en: I’ll have to crush its head like you would a snake- for severing it would be too painful and freezing it would be too slow. And I can’t fit one more girl in my freezer or there will be no space for Barbara’s favorite movie.
lines.zh: 我将不得不像对付蛇那样碾碎它的头——因为斩断太痛,冷冻太慢。而我的冰柜里塞不下再多一个女孩了,不然就没有地方放 Barbara 最喜欢的电影了。

lines.en: I stumble across or upon a special room for special boys while I am searching for special eyes.
lines.zh: 在我寻找特殊眼睛的途中,我跌跌撞撞地发现——或者说撞上——一间给特殊男孩准备的特殊房间。

lines.en: Three seconds later, a special girl appears.
lines.zh: 三秒后,一位特殊女孩出现了。

lines.en: : Bubblegoop and thimblebop. Who’s a special lemondrop?
lines.zh: : 泡泡咕噜,顶针嘣嘣。谁是特殊的小柠檬糖?

lines.en: : I am.
: Right you are and wrong you’re not. Be careful or you’ll ruin the plot.
lines.zh: : 你说得对,也没说错。小心点,不然你会毁掉剧情。

lines.en: : But this is my story. I can’t ruin my own story.
lines.zh: : 可这是我的故事。我没法毁掉自己的故事。

lines.en: : If anything, the increased inclusion of these seemingly pointless and arguably paranormal entities is ruining the plot. The feature creep and scope of this game is getting out of hand.
lines.zh: : 硬要说的话,不断加入这些看似毫无意义、堪称超常的存在,才是在毁掉剧情。这款游戏的功能蔓延和体量,已经快失控了。

lines.en: : Out of hand or out of heart? The world is big, but you are nart.
lines.zh: : 失控,还是失心?世界很大,但你是 nart。

lines.en: : Nart?
lines.zh: : nart?

lines.en: : I am from Australia.
lines.zh: : 我来自澳大利亚。

lines.en: : I am sorry for making fun of your accent.
lines.zh: : 抱歉取笑了你的口音。

lines.en: : Why have you stepped into my garden, young warrior?
lines.zh: : 你为何踏进我的花园,年轻的战士?

lines.en: : I am no warrior. I am but a lightningslug chomping through foliage on my way to an orphan. Can you please tell me where the restroom is?
lines.zh: : 我不是战士。我只是一只闪电蛞蝓,正啃食着枝叶,走在去往一个孤儿的路上。能告诉我洗手间在哪儿吗?

lines.en: : You may relieve yourself in the southern flowerbed. It’s where the lilies are kept. Your fecal matter will serve as excellent manure in place of your blood.
lines.zh: : 你可以在南侧花坛里解决。那里养着百合。你的排遗将成为绝佳的肥料,替代你的血。

lines.en: : Thank you. I will make sure your flowers stay beautiful, young woman.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。我会确保你的花保持美丽,年轻的女人。

lines.en: : You may call me Floral Laura. I am the one-thousand-and-eighth god.
lines.zh: : 你可以叫我花神 Laura。我是第一千零八位神明。

lines.en: : Jesus.
lines.zh: : 耶稣。

lines.en: : No, Jesus is the forty-third.
lines.zh: : 不,耶稣是第四十三位。

lines.en: : Have you come to recruit me as well, Floral Laura?
lines.zh: : 你也是来招募我的吗,花神 Laura?

lines.en: : I have little interest in recruitment, Pee Boy.
lines.zh: : 我对招募没什么兴趣,尿尿男孩。

lines.en: : Who told you my nickname and why don’t you want my resume?
lines.zh: : 谁告诉你我外号的?还有,你为什么不要我的简历?

lines.en: : Even all the way out here, word from the office still reaches me. But I have long since cared about those who choose to follow the hedgemaze.
lines.zh: : 就算远在这里,「办公室」的风声依然传得到我这儿。但那些选择追随树篱迷宫的人,我早就不在乎了。

lines.en: : I have accepted a life of solitude, where I may tend to my children and watch them slowly grow and die.
lines.zh: : 我已接受了独居的生活——照料我的孩子们,看他们慢慢生长,慢慢死去。

lines.en: : I’m in a similar quagmire, Miss Laura. But at this rate, I’m afraid my flowers will grow forever and one day consume the land as time itself does not permit their death.
lines.zh: : 我也陷在类似的泥潭里,Laura 女士。但照这样下去,恐怕我的花会永远生长,终有一天吞噬大地——因为时间本身不容许它们死亡。

lines.en: : Their growth will cease eventually, sweetest pea. There is only so much water for them to drink up.
lines.zh: : 它们的生长终会停止的,最甜的豌豆。可供它们喝干的水,也就那么多。

lines.en: : If I were you, I would focus more on crafting an environment conducive to their continued betterment. And fill each plot with peppermint.
lines.zh: : 我要是你,就会更专注于打造一个有利于它们持续向好的环境。并且每块地里都种满薄荷。

lines.en: : Why peppermint?
lines.zh: : 为什么是薄荷?

lines.en: : It helps with their digestion and will increase their color. And if there is anything you should have garnered or gardened from your meeting prior to this one, it’s that color is important.
lines.zh: : 它有助于消化,还能加深它们的颜色。如果说这次会面之前的那场会面里,你该收获或「园艺」出什么道理,那就是:颜色很重要。

lines.en: : Color is colorful. It’s what gives us color. And life is a lot like a coloring book for people like you who can’t grow children like me.
lines.zh: : 颜色是彩色的。正是它赋予我们颜色。而对像你这种养不出我这样的孩子的人来说,人生很像一本涂色书。

lines.en: : You can say that again. I’ve been violating [[redacted] FLOWERS for years now and am currently very conflicted about why I’m totally cool with that but not the slightly more [[redacted] FLOWERS.
lines.zh: : 这话我爱听。多年来我一直在侵犯 [[已遮蔽] 的花,而且眼下我非常纠结:为什么我对那个完全没意见,对稍微更 [[已遮蔽] 的花就过不去。

lines.en: : Life would be so much better without faulty directions in my moral compass that keep guiding me back toward blissful ignorance.
lines.zh: : 要是我的道德罗盘里没有那些故障指向、老是把我引回幸福的无知,人生会好过多。

lines.en: : It is my garden. Why do I leave one patch un-trampled while incessantly grazing on the rest?
lines.zh: : 这是我的花园。为什么我留下一块地不踩,却在其余地方不断放牧?

lines.en: : This is a question you must answer yourself, I’m afraid. I have no interest in life’s more carnal pleasures.
lines.zh: : 恐怕这个问题,你得自己回答。我对人生中那些更肉欲的乐子没有兴趣。

lines.en: : All that matters to me is my garden.
lines.zh: : 对我来说,要紧的只有我的花园。

lines.en: : And all that matters to me is mine.
lines.zh: : 对我来说,要紧的只有「我的」。

lines.en: : Then you already have your answer.
lines.zh: : 那你已经握有答案了。

lines.en: : Wait, Floral Laura. Please do not go.
lines.zh: : 等等,花神 Laura。请别走。

lines.en: : I’m just over here now.
lines.zh: : 我只是挪到这儿了而已。

lines.en: : Oh, sorry. I’m not used to character sprites anymore.
lines.zh: : 哦,抱歉。我已经不习惯角色立绘了。

lines.en: : I understand. But my corpseflower requires water. It’s been very thirsty lately.
lines.zh: : 我理解。但我的尸花需要水。它最近渴得很。

lines.en: : You are a good parent.
lines.zh: : 你是个好家长。

lines.en: : Anything for the florum, lightningslug. I will never be able to compete without it. Which is why I’m so confused about why the others spend so much time and energy watering those who can drink on their own.
lines.zh: : 为了 florum,什么都行,闪电蛞蝓。没有它,我永远无法竞争。所以我也才这么困惑:为什么其他家伙愿意花那么多时间和精力,去浇灌那些自己会喝水的东西。

lines.en: : Flowers can drink on their own too if you put them outside. But instead you’ve decided to keep them captive.
lines.zh: : 只要放到外面,花其实也能自己喝水。可你偏偏决定把它们囚起来。

lines.en: : Because I’m a special girl who makes special decisions. Just like how you were placed in a pot rather than left outside to flourish.
lines.zh: : 因为我是个会做特殊决定的特殊女孩。就像你被放进花盆,而不是丢在外面自生自灭一样。

lines.en: : But that would mean I can’t drink on my own, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 可那不就意味着,我没办法自己喝水了吗?

lines.en: : You are smart. I see now why the rumors have begun to spread.
lines.zh: : 你很聪明。我现在明白谣言为什么开始传开了。

lines.en: : Thanks. I’m trying. I’ve just been struggling when it comes to motivation lately.
lines.zh: : 谢了。我在努力。只是最近,动力这块一直很挣扎。

lines.en: : You forgot to water one, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你忘浇了一盆,对吧?

lines.en: : Maybe you are just as special as me then. And maybe one day, someone will wind up in your garden who isn’t meant to be there.
lines.zh: : 也许,你其实和我一样特殊。也许有一天,会有一个不该在那里的人,落进你的花园。

lines.en: : What will you do then?
lines.zh: : 到那时,你会怎么做?

lines.en: you weren’t there when the sky opened. and you will not be there when it closes.
lines.zh: 天开启的时候,你不在。天闭合的时候,你也不会在。

lines.en: but there are those who stay long after the lights go out.
lines.zh: 但有一些人,在灯熄灭之后,仍会停留很久很久。

lines.en: they clean the floors and refill the paper plates with items kept in closets people like us never think to open.
lines.zh: 他们擦净地板,把纸盘重新添满——用的是那些藏在壁橱里、我们这种人从来想不到要打开的东西。

lines.en: through all the late nights and prayers prayed by your bedside, those people have always existed.
lines.zh: 穿过所有深夜,穿过你床边祷念的祈祷,那些人一直都在。

lines.en: they do not turn the wheels, but grease them.
lines.zh: 他们不转动车轮,却为车轮上油。

lines.en: they do not tell the story, but copy it down.
lines.zh: 他们不讲述故事,却把故事抄录下来。

lines.en: these are the unsung heroes who we neglect as our instinct tells us they belong in the background.
lines.zh: 这些是无名英雄——本能告诉我们,他们属于背景,于是我们将他们忽略。

lines.en: it tells us they are not important.
lines.zh: 本能告诉我们,他们不重要。

lines.en: but it is you who was never meant to be the star.
lines.zh: 但从来不该当主角的,其实是你。

lines.en: that’s why all of the others are gone now.
lines.zh: 这就是为什么,其他所有人现在都不在了。

lines.en: and all that’s left is a hole.
lines.zh: 而剩下的,只有一个洞。

lines.en: CTRL-C
lines.zh: CTRL-C

lines.en: CTRL-V
lines.zh: CTRL-V

lines.en: : Nao? Are you out there somewhere?
lines.zh: : Nao?你在外面某个地方吗?

lines.en: Of course she’s out here somewhere. There’s nowhere else for her to go.
lines.zh: 她当然在外面的某个地方。她无处可去。

lines.en: The only question is whether or not I’ll be able to find her. And how I’ll manage to bring her back even if I do as I’ve been searching for so long at this point that I’m not even sure if I know where I am anymore.
lines.zh: 唯一的问题是我能不能找到她。以及就算找到了,我要怎么把她带回去——毕竟我找了这么久,久到连自己身在何处都不确定了。

lines.en: But hey, this just gives me extra motivation to find her since she’d be several days’ worth of food in the event that I really do get stuck out here.
lines.zh: 不过嘛,这反倒给了我找到她的额外动力——万一我真被困在这里,她可是好几天的口粮。
: Nao?……

lines.en: : Hello?...
lines.zh: : 有人吗?……

lines.en: : Clap if you can hear me or something...
lines.zh: : 听得见的话就拍拍手什么的……

lines.en: There’s something unsettling about being out here.
lines.zh: 待在这里,有一种说不出的不安。

lines.en: It’s not the fear that I could become some animal’s lunch and it’s not the fact that I don’t know where I am.
lines.zh: 不是怕自己沦为某种动物的午餐,也不是因为我不知道自己身在何处。

lines.en: It’s this creeping feeling that I’m about to stumble onto or into something I’m not ready for.
lines.zh: 而是那种令人毛骨悚然的感觉:我即将撞上、或撞进某个我还没准备好面对的东西。

lines.en: It’s this painful uncertainty and distrust in my environment that half comes from knowing this place is anything but normal, while the other half comes from an innate distrust in the world as a whole.
lines.zh: 那是一种令人痛苦的疑虑,和对周围环境的不信任——一半来自我知道这地方绝不正常,另一半来自我对整个世界与生俱来的不信任。

lines.en: This is not somewhere I am happy to inhabit. This is not somewhere I understand.
lines.zh: 这不是一个我乐于栖身的地方。这不是一个我能理解的地方。

lines.en: And I hesitate to call it “somewhere” at all when, more often than not, walking around feels more like swimming through blank space.
lines.zh: 而很多时候,走在其中更像在空白里游泳,连称它为「某个地方」都让我犹豫。

lines.en: I allow myself to crawl deeper into the void.
lines.zh: 我允许自己往虚空更深处爬去。

lines.en: And I eventually emerge in an actual “somewhere.”
lines.zh: 最终,我浮出在一个真正的「某个地方」。

lines.en: : There you are...
lines.zh: : 找到你了……

lines.en: : We’re going to need to get you a phone or something so you don’t wind up getting lost in the future. Wandering around on your own at your age isn’t exactly smart, you know?
lines.zh: : 以后得给你配个手机之类的,免得你哪天又迷路。你这个年纪还独自到处乱逛,可不太聪明,知道吗?

lines.en: : What’s that?
lines.zh: : 那是什么?

lines.en: //////////////////////USER 2 HAS CONNECTED VIA HOT SPOT
lines.zh: //////////////////////USER 2 HAS CONNECTED VIA HOT SPOT

lines.en: //////////////////////PLEASE ACCEPT THE CONNECTION BY-
lines.zh: //////////////////////PLEASE ACCEPT THE CONNECTION BY-

lines.en: no. do not accept that-
lines.zh: 不要。别接受那个——

lines.en: DO NOT OPEN THE DOOR
lines.zh: 不许打开那扇门

lines.en: i FUCKING told YOU to NOT accept THAT fucking-
lines.zh: 我他妈的告诉过「你」不要接受「那个」该死的——

lines.en: The voices go dark and I’m left here with an unflavored conscience, but I’m too busy drowning in confusion to revel in the silence.
lines.zh: 声音暗了下去,只剩我和一颗没入任何滋味的心智,但我正忙着在困惑里溺水,无暇享受这片寂静。

lines.en: For once, the sound of my heartbeat is all I can hear. But even that is quieted by the deafening aura bleeding off of the structure before us.
lines.zh: 生平头一遭,我能听见的只剩自己的心跳。但就连它,也被我们面前那座建筑渗出的震耳气场压了下去。

lines.en: This place is not meant to be here. And we were not meant to find it.
lines.zh: 这地方本不该存在于此。而我们,本不该找到它。

lines.en: Nao stands still, just as I do, gazing up at the words “Salvation lies within” and likely having no clue what such a thing could possibly mean in a situation like this.
lines.zh: Nao 一动不动,和我一样,仰头望着「救赎,就在其中」那几个字,多半完全不明白,在这种境况里这话能是什么意思。

lines.en: We’re so far out here that nothing should exist. And yet here we are, swatting bugs off of our necks and questioning whether or not we’ve been stripped of our sanity by the world we call “home.”
lines.zh: 我们身在如此之远的地方,远到什么都不该存在。可我们就在这里,拍打着脖子上的虫子,怀疑自己是否已被那个我们称之为「家」的世界剥夺了理智。

lines.en: Did she...know this was here?
lines.zh: 她……知道这里有这东西吗?

lines.en: That can’t possibly be the case, could it?
lines.zh: 不可能吧,对吗?

lines.en: If it was...she wouldn’t be gazing up at it in disbelief like me, right?
lines.zh: 如果她知道……她就不会像我一样难以置信地仰望着它,对吧?

lines.en: If she knew it was here, she’d be opening the door by now. Or trying to coerce me into heading in.
lines.zh: 要是她知道它在这里,这会儿早该去开门了。或者正逼着我进去。

lines.en: But instead, the two of us just stand here like petrified deer gazing at the headlights of an oncoming car, not quite accepting that we’re about to die but more or less not being able to comprehend it.
lines.zh: 可相反,我们俩只是站在这里,像两只被车灯钉住的鹿,凝视着驶来汽车的大灯——谈不上接受自己即将死去,只是多多少少无法理解这件事。

lines.en: : What do you think we should do?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我们该怎么办?

lines.en: I ask the question we’ve both been wondering. And it’s one of the few cases so far where I feel like I’ve been able to understand her.
lines.zh: 我问出了我们俩都在想的问题。而这也是目前为止为数不多、我觉得自己真能读懂她的时刻之一。

lines.en: She doesn’t answer.
lines.zh: 她没有回答。

lines.en: But I know what she wants.
lines.zh: 但我知道她想要什么。

lines.en: Slowly, we make our way over to the staircase.
lines.zh: 我们慢慢朝那段楼梯走去。

lines.en: A sweet scent lingers under the cement awning, likely the result of something from inside the room bleeding through the crack beneath its red door.
lines.zh: 水泥雨棚下残留着一股甜香,多半是房间里什么东西,从那扇红门底下的缝隙渗出来的结果。

lines.en: I’m the first one to ascend.
lines.zh: 我先上去。

lines.en: Nao grabs onto my sleeve and, for a moment, it feels like she’s trying to pull me back down.
lines.zh: Nao 抓住我的袖子,有那么一瞬,感觉她像是要把我拉回去。

lines.en: She second guesses herself, which makes me second guess myself.
lines.zh: 她犹豫了,而这让我也犹豫了。

lines.en: But she ultimately submits and stops pulling.
lines.zh: 但她最终还是让了步,松了手。

lines.en: And I ascend further.
lines.zh: 我继续向上。

lines.en: But I’m assaulted by a sharp pain in my head with each passing step.
lines.zh: 但每上一级,一阵尖锐的头痛便突袭一次我的脑袋。

lines.en: My body takes up the mantle that Nao wore just moments ago in a last-ditch effort to try and protect me from something, but it’s no use.
lines.zh: 我的身体接过了 Nao 方才披上的那件斗篷,做最后的努力,试图保护我免受什么东西的伤害,但没有用。

lines.en: I’m a human after all. Curiosity has spelled the demise of far better men than me.
lines.zh: 我终究只是个人类。好奇心早已葬送了比我好得多的人。

lines.en: Perhaps I’ll be the next?
lines.zh: 也许下一个就是我?

lines.en: Or perhaps what’s inside of this room will be the key I’ve been searching for all along?
lines.zh: 又或许,这个房间里的东西,正是我一直在找的那把钥匙?

lines.en: There is only one way to find out.
lines.zh: 答案只有一种办法能知道。

lines.en: : What the fuck?
lines.zh: : 搞什么鬼?

lines.en: Now what should I do?
lines.zh: 现在,我该怎么办?
